methodology.latency: One local end-to-end sample per state/arm; includes fixture construction, evidence computation, serialization and verification. Excludes real network, inference and production pacing. One-minute token capacity is simulated using the production payload estimator and 30,000-token ceiling; over-cap attempts fail without dispatch. Nearest-rank median/p95. Never compare with live latency gates.
methodology.tokens: Input = ceil(serialized request UTF-8 bytes/3)+256 framing; scripted output = ceil(output bytes/3). Reservation includes full 1800 output tokens per request. Repeated history is counted each turn. No tokenizer or provider usage; not an invoice.
methodology.baseline: A runs the complete existing assessment and three pre-surge guided questions on current code; it is a feature ablation, not a historical binary. B adds deterministic route comparison. C/D run the same production answerQuestion/provider/verification path with fixed/adaptive scripts, copying the registry supplied to every model. No private gold labels reach scripts.
methodology.attribution: Only hand-labelled useful facts absent from A receive additional-evidence credit. All such facts in these cases are deterministic route arithmetic. Queries and replay illustrations alone receive no new-fact credit. C/D gain versus B is measured against the same useful-fact rubric, not inferred from request success. Attempted follow-up queries include capacity-fallback runs. Relevance means an exact in-scope aggregate or a hand-labelled diagnostic replay anchor; it is not a human utility rating. Presentation safety is checked through typed verdicts, registered interpretations, exact numeric/citation oracles and required caveat text; unrestricted prose is not judged by a model.
methodology.scope: 14 authored synthetic diagnostics in 7 correlated families. No held-out recorded-match or blinded-human study; proposal generalization, live completion, human preference and live cost/latency gates remain unmet.
